Zucker]] {{C|Book design}} |illustrator= |editor=[[Betsy Mitchell]] |publisher=[[Del Rey]]{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/211558/heir-to-the-empire-star-wars-legends-by-timothy-zahn/9780345528292|text=Heir to the Empire: Star Wars Legends}} {{C|Hardcover}} |early release= |release date=[[September 6]], [[2011]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=*Hardcover *eBook{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/211558/heir-to-the-empire-star-wars-legends-by-timothy-zahn/9780345530004|text=Heir to the Empire: Star Wars Legends}} {{C|eBook}} |pages=496 |isbn=9780345528292 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=N/A |timeline=[[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]'' |preceded by= |followed by=''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' }} '''''Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition''''' is a reissue of the [[1991]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' by [[Timothy Zahn]]. This special twentieth-anniversary edition includes a new introduction by Zahn, a new foreword by [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Howard Roffman]], annotations by Zahn and editor [[Betsy Mitchell]], and an all-new novella by Zahn, ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', featuring [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. It was published by [[Del Rey]] on [[September 6]], [[2011]].
